help.title: === PvPCalc help ===
help.1: /pvpcalc on | off | reset - tracking switch, clear the CSV session
help.3: /pvpcalc settings - open the settings screen (key O), /pvpcalc config export|import|reset
help.4: /pvpcalc version 1.8|1.9+ | target looked|self | shield on|off | difficulty | units | decimals
help.5: /pvpcalc calc | gear | stats | matchover | report copy | recommend <player> | records | streaks | goal | trend
help.6: /pvpcalc hack status | track | untrack | check <player> | threshold | sensitivity | whitelist | simulate
help.7: /pvpcalc language en|fi | quiet on|off | music play <disc> | check | update | status [all]
help.8: Short aliases: /pvp and /hack. Commands also work in Finnish (e.g. /pvpcalc ohje). Estimates are not proof.

s.chk.limit.d: Limit in the check's own unit: reach blocks, speed ratio, fly ticks, aim degrees, CPS, knockback blocks, fall blocks, totem ticks, mace damage.
s.chk.on.d: Experimental checks (velocity, nofall, autototem, mace) are off by default and may give false alerts.
s.enabled.d: Master switch (same as /pvpcalc on and off).
s.language.d: Language of all texts. Commands work in both languages.
s.chatPrefix.d: Text in front of mod messages.
s.messageCooldown.d: The same message is not repeated within this time.
s.updateNotice.d: Notice only, nothing is downloaded. Reads public GitHub release info.
s.performanceMode.d: Fewer analysed players and a longer update interval.
s.quietMode.d: Alerts and reports come only after the match.
s.serverPresets.d: Apply ready settings for known servers and tell what was chosen.
s.kit.d: Changing the kit starts a new match.
s.target.d: Calculate damage on the player you look at, or on yourself.
s.assumeShield.d: Treat the opponent as blocking (1.9+: 0 damage, 1.8: sword block halves).
s.difficulty.d: Scales explosion damage. Vanilla melee between players is not scaled.
s.cooldownAssumption.d: Use the current attack charge or assume a full charge.
s.critHandling.d: auto = only when falling, always, or off.
s.cps18.d: Clicks per second assumed for time-to-kill in 1.8 mode.
s.spearFactor.d: Custom spear: damage x (1 + factor x velocity).
s.smpMode.d: Unlimited loot: show only what was used, guess gear from what is visible.
s.matchInactivity.d: Ends the match after this many seconds without action. 0 = off.
s.trendWindow.d: How many recent matches the trend compares (1-100).
s.hack.centerText.d: Shows the reason in the middle of the screen.
s.hack.minRowSeconds.d: One HACK ALERT row per player per interval.
s.hack.confirmCount.d: How many violations are needed inside the window.
s.hack.pingLimit.d: Above this the results are marked unreliable.
s.hack.tpsComp.d: Lowers sensitivity when the server lags.
s.hack.training.d: Analyse yourself: normal play must stay green.
s.hack.baseline.d: Compare a player with their own normal behaviour.
s.hack.falsePositives.d: Situations that skip checks (all or a comma list: elytra,wind_charge,firework,pearl,explosion,vehicle,water,lava,climb,levitation,slow_fall,teleport,respawn,knockback,lunge,block,gamemode,lag,soft).
s.hud.rule.d: always, only holding a weapon, or only after a hit.
s.hud.durability.d: Shows durability and the piece with the least left (XP bottle target).
s.hud.mace.d: Blocks to fall to kill/pop the opponent.
s.csv.delimiter.d: comma or semicolon (semicolon opens directly in Finnish Excel).
s.csv.maxMb.d: Larger files are archived as session_data_N.csv.
s.csv.formulaProtect.d: Prevents cells from being run as formulas.
s.safeMode.d: Switch off a module that keeps failing.
s.tickBudgetMs.d: The cheat analysis backs off if it takes longer.
